args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring
requiring ROUND_HALF_EVEN, causing nightly failures in
tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which broke the nightly build at `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` → `2.66`, not `2.67`).
- This change switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
